messages:
anna-devinfra: Heads up — planning a night maintenance window to do a slow drain + rolling reboot on a small cohort across eu-west3 and us-east1. Window: 2025-04-21 02:00-04:00 UTC. Expectation: staggered node drains (4 nodes per region), kv-cache pre-seed, and a thermal sanity check. No mass evacs.
prateek-sre: +1. Can we canary on 1 node in each region 02:00-02:15, then proceed if OK? I'll run the live canary tests.
liz-engops: What impact for Dedicated pools? Any pinned tenants we should notify earlier?
michael-oncall: Dedicated pools will be isolated — but tenants on shared pools may see brief slower queueing while kv-cache warms. Recommend setting routing fallback to the compatible lower-capacity pool for the window.
tara-support: Please tag the tenant list here if there are any customers with usage SLAs so we can send comms. I can prepare a targeted email and status page update.
anna-devinfra: (typo) anna-devinfra: Updated: affected pools = shared-gpu-eu, shared-gpu-us. No dedicated reboots planned. I've attached the quick rollback plan in the runbook link: https://our-internal/runbooks/rolling-drain-2025.
prateek-sre: Runbook snippet I'm going to follow:
```
# canary
kubectl drain node-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
# validate
curl -sS http://canary.probe/health || rollback
```
liz-engops: Cost note — backfill traffic will increase token-economy by ~0.6% for that hour (est). Flagging billing to watch for spike.
michael-oncall: I'll open a transient capacity reservation to cover backfill if the canary fails. Need approval from infra-costs?
anna-devinfra: tagging cost-approver: @liz-engops (already). If we see >1% token cost increase we'll abort and reschedule.
tara-support: Draft status page blurb: "We will perform a rolling reboot of a small number of nodes in eu-west3 and us-east1 between 02:00-04:00 UTC. Some requests may be routed to warm fallback pools; customers on shared pools may experience slight latency increase. No data loss expected." Want me to post this at 01:30 UTC?
prateek-sre: yep post at 01:30. I'll post canary results to this thread at 02:20.
ops-bot: calendar created: maintenance: night-cohort-warmdrain (2025-04-21 02:00-04:00 UTC). Pager schedule preserved. Reference: #INC000842345.
liz-engops: LGTM. tagging support playbook: @tara-support please prep escalation steps for any dedicated-customer-visible regressions.
anna-devinfra: Thanks all. Final checklist: pre-seed KV-cache at 01:45, post canary verify qps/latency at 02:20, monitor token cost and backfill. I'll push the node drain plan 01:50. :thumbsup:
